8214.title: Repeated validator compilation during workflow reads
8214.rootCauseOneLine: Stored call inspection compiles every output schema, and run-view metadata extraction also revalidates literal source schemas on every read.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — direction matches the verified cause
prReviews.topFinding: No PR code executed; existing RPC regression does not directly cover history.

8214.proposedFix: Separate safe stored-schema checks from compilation and use metadata-only extraction for views. Existing open PR #8215 already targets this issue; no duplicate fix opened.
8214.caveats: Counts reproduced twice; original millisecond benchmarks and live UI refetch amplification not measured. Initial full monorepo build hit an unrelated SDK-dist ordering failure; focused preparation and 292 existing workflow tests passed.
